title: Metals Glazed
description: Texturepack that change the default Glazed Terracote textures to metalic blocks.
body:
![Metals Textures banner](https://i.imgur.com/urJyvXg.png)
![Metals Glazed ](https://i.imgur.com/ZjcX3sn.png)
![Metals before and after](https://i.imgur.com/KYShyb6.png)

This Resourcepack replace the Glazed Terracota Texture for Metalic versions, so they look more futuristic, ideal for space builds.
